baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. Baseline sources and Cargo files checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree streaming single-trail cursors through intermediate WITH DISTINCT. Each stage compares typed projected keys across incoming rows, retaining independent seen sets before pagination and downstream expansion. Ordinary page guards remain unchanged; DISTINCT evaluates skipped keys.
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, fixture and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, per-row validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. distinct-entities: depth 10, 2046 trails and 20480 path-node members (including start nodes filtered out); WITH DISTINCT n retains 10 nodes, then a range of 32 emits 320 rows. distinct-unique: depth 12, WITH DISTINCT p,b retains 8190 unique path/endpoint keys, then range(1,4) emits 32760 rows. distinct-page: depth 12, UNWIND nodes(p), WITH DISTINCT n SKIP 2 LIMIT 10 WHERE n.id>0, then range(1,128), yields 1280 rows from 10 admitted keys; eager enumeration has 8190 potential trails and 98304 node members. Per-node/depth counts, member sums/squared sums, and member bounds validate bags. Unordered pages may select different node IDs; per-selected-key multiplicity and total cardinality are checked independently. First mode validates one result without asserting representative order. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, default retained traversal memory. Final scalar outputs exclude hydration; unique path keys remain compact in the seen set.

queries.distinct-entities: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->() UNWIND nodes(p) AS n WITH DISTINCT n WHERE n.id>0 UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member RETURN n.id AS hops,n.id AS endpoint,member
queries.distinct-unique: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->(b) WITH DISTINCT p,b UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member RETURN length(p) AS hops,b.id AS endpoint,member
queries.distinct-page: MATCH p=(:Start)-[:NEXT*]->() UNWIND nodes(p) AS n WITH DISTINCT n SKIP 2 LIMIT 10 WHERE n.id>0 UNWIND range(1,$fanout) AS member RETURN n.id AS hops,n.id AS endpoint,member
